build_YOLACT_detector: build a YOLACT instance segmentation model with backbone, neck, bbox_head, and mask_head configs
extract_feat_YOLACT: extract multi-level feature tensors from input images using the YOLACT backbone and neck
loss_YOLACT: compute bounding box and mask losses for a batch of training images and ground truth data samples
predict_YOLACT: predict instance segmentation results including scores, labels, bboxes, and masks for input images
review_YOLACT_init: review the YOLACT constructor to understand required backbone, neck, bbox_head, and mask_head config parameters
